"id": "E00",
      "title": "Extend condition expressions through a bounded semantic profile",
      "layer": "L4",
      "depends_on": [
        "P11"
      ],
      "status": "planned-not-implemented",
      "selection": "optional-separate-profile",
      "problem": "Current conditions are exact externally supplied evaluations, not an expression execution language.",
      "implementation_steps": [
        "First define a finite expression AST, exact leaf EvaluationKey, total truth tables and how invalid evidence propagates; begin with a bounded positive conjunction/disjunction fragment.",
        "Prove activation soundness/completeness against independent expression meaning and key preservation; specify missing/contradictory/revised-leaf cases.",
        "Then add versioned expression/assessment schemas, evaluator and actual Lean witnesses, followed by mapped-norm integration and worked review."
      ],
      "contract": "New condition-expression profile; old atomic profile remains selectable. No arbitrary code execution or absence-as-false.",
      "formal_targets": [
        "proposed: evalExpr(expr,context)=holds iff the independent selected expression meaning holds under its supplied leaf assumptions"
      ],
      "negative_controls": [
        "Unknown leaf; contradictory leaf; changed revision; shared-name/different-epoch leaf.",
        "Short circuit masks invalid evidence; nested expression exceeds bounds."
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Independent truth tables are reviewed before runtime.",
        "Full bounded expression witness and tests precede norm activation.",
        "Unsupported operators stay explicit."
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "ExpressionSemantics.lean",
        "expression.schema.json",
        "evaluator.py",
        "expression-review.md"
      ],
      "cost": "high",
      "write_scope": "craft/formalization/candidates/relational-theorem-checker/v3/e00/",
      "authority_effect": "none"
    },
    {

## E00: bounded condition expressions

Define a small expression tree with evidence-backed atomic conditions, conjunction, disjunction and negation. An atomic condition returns yes, no or unknown at its exact evaluation key. Fix every operator's truth table independently of the evaluator. Unknown input is not silently converted to false; unsupported operators are explicit refusals. Contradictory supplied evaluations remain a separate invalid-input condition rather than a way to derive arbitrary truth.

Implement closed expression/evaluation schemas with depth, node and work ceilings. Compile a concrete expression witness and the independently specified interpretation into Lean before permitting norm activation. The activation theorem must connect the exact expression, context, subject, target, scope and epoch to an active norm. A Python evaluator agreeing with itself is insufficient.

Review every truth-table row, nested unknown cases, conflicting evaluations, stale context, unsupported operators and cutoff behavior. External atomic evaluation truth stays a named assumption. No arbitrary executable condition string is introduced.

criteria.criterion: Independent truth tables are reviewed before runtime.
Full bounded expression witness and tests precede norm activation.

decisions.decision: Fix Strong Kleene atom/and/or/not truth independently, then compiled equality with dual-rail denotation before evaluator and activation.
decisions.resolution: Separate condition-expression-v1; all leaf evidence validated before evaluation; no short-circuit hides invalidity

decisions.decision: Bound expression nodes/depth and exact context/subject/target/scope/epoch keys.
decisions.resolution: Missing leaves unknown; contradictory or mismatched supplied leaf evidence invalid; atomic legacy remains selectable
